record.question: According to the IPHS 2022, Urban Health and Wellness Centre caters how much population?
record.explanation: Answer C: 15000 - 20000. IPHS 2022 and NUHM planning use a population norm of about 15,000–20,000 for an Urban Health and Wellness Centre. Reference: https://www.nhm.gov.in/images/pdf/guidelines/iphs/iphs-revised-guidlines-2022/04-SHC_HWC_UHWC_IPHS_Guidelines-2022.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
